subject.scene_narrative: A pair of gloved hands plants a seedling into a shared raised garden bed while the other hand waters it with a small can, a soft arc of water catching the light. A seed packet and hand trowel rest nearby. The scene reads as warm, communal urban gardening — nurturing a shared green space together.
